Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

precise surgery.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.
[ Cardiovascular ][173]
[ Orthopaedics ][174]

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine
[Ultimate victory]

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ Explore orthopaedic reconstruction ][91]

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

### The reliable global partner who knows your business

AccuPath Group Co., Ltd. (briefly “ AccuPath^{®} ” ) is an innovative high-tech group that is
committed to improving human life and health through advanced materials and manufacturing science
and technology.

In the high-end medical device industry, we provide integrated services that include polymer
materials, metal materials, smart materials, membrane materials, CDMO, and testing. “Our mission is
to provide interventional medical devices components & CDMO solutions for global high-end medical
device companies”.

With R&D and production bases located in Shanghai, Jiaxing, China, and California, USA, we have
formed a global ntework of R&D, production, marketing, and service. Our vision is to “become a
global advanced material and advanced manufacturing high-tech enterprise”.

# Aneurysm
# Remodelling
# DEVICES

Our products are innovative devices designed to treat 95% of cerebral aneurysms and are currently
targeted for use in challenging wide-neck bifurcations. eCLIPs effectively treats an aneurysm by
bridging the neck, creating flow effect, and providing scaffolding to enable endothelial growth.

[Close up shot of the eCLIPS medical device. ]

# NECK BRIDGING
* Deployment is as effective as the most deliverable neuro stent
* Full retractable & repositionable prior to detachment
* Non-migrating design prevents inadvertent movement of device
* One size serves a wide spectrum of aneurysm and neck sizes

[An illustration of the eCLIPS device treating an aneurysm. ]

# Unique Spine Rib Design
* Applicable to both bifurcations and sidewall aneurysms
* No need to enter the fragile aneurysm sac
* Ability to cross for coiling
* Non-shortening

[Illustration showing the size of the flow diverting leaf segment and the anchor segment. ]

# IDEAL FOR BIFURCATIONS

Bridges the neck, resulting in:
* Significant flow diversion
* Effective coil retention
* Mitigated water hammer effect
* Provides platform for endothelial growth

THE POWER

THE POWER

 GDLS BRAND FILM

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

solutions consultancy, providing bespoke solutions to enterprises across multiple industry verticals
and geographies. Our mission is to assimilate, synthesize and map today’s complex business
environments to predict market movements accurately. With a team of highly-experienced research and
data analysts focused on analytical thinking and through a suite of revenue impact solutions
developed using the knowledge of emerging markets, Global Market Studies is able to add real value
to clients’ decision-making process so they may stay ahead of change.

OUR SERVICES

Accurate market data is crucial to a successful business strategy. With an 85% + accuracy in all
reports, makes us one of the best and most accurate firms in the world.

### Syndicated Research

We are focused on identifying major market opportunities that promise high growth. Our syndicated
market research studies provide an overall market overview regarding emerging market opportunities
across a range of domains.

With our global approach to market intelligence, we are able to offer value-add consulting services
to new as well as seasoned organizations. Our priority is to help you discover growth and revenue
opportunities.

We offer in-depth company and industry reporting, analysis into new developments and ongoing trends,
the regulatory environment and its effect on business to enable businesses to achieve operation
excellence.

We offer carefully curated reports designed to cater to the ever-changing needs of your business.

higher than industry standards.

Our team of experts is spread across 150 countries to get you the most current and up-to-date data
for your report requirements

**CUSTOMISED SOLUTIONS**

We specialize in providing bespoke and tailor-made reports suited to your specific requirements and
the most cost-effective price-points.

**RAPID DELIVERY**

Our vast database of market insights and intelligence and an ever-expanding network of global
experts helps us ensure you are provided the best revenue impact solutions within tight deadlines.

**CROSS-VERTICAL EXPERTISE**

Our team of analysts comes with several decades of experience across sectors and geographies to give
you the most current, accurate and insightful data

**ROBUST METHODOLOGY**

With the right mix of primary research, secondary research, data triangulation, quality control and

## What patients say about us?

Check out the stories of our satisfied patients. See how we can help you too.

### ‘SUCCESS,’ Cries Pain Patient After Gamma Knife Treatment

“I woke up on Wednesday the 9th Oct, 2013 without that pain that was gonna drive me right out of my
mind. Thank goodness. And especially thank you. I’ve been afraid to say it was gone for fear it
would come back…”

Read More...

### ‘Rumors of My Death Have Been Greatly Exaggerated’

Elyse remembers, “That’s when the emergency room doctor came and said, ‘I have good news and bad
news. The good news is your blood work is great. The bad news is you have brain aneurysms…’”

Read More...

### After Surgery for Chiari Malformation, Linda Laughs Again

Her symptoms started with headaches that came on when she laughed or coughed. Gradually, the
headaches got more frequent and more severe. After a few years, her doctor sent her to get an MRI…

Read More...

### Another Chance at Childhood

When she was eleven years old, Gianna Rodriguez had her annual physical exam. What was supposed to
be a routine check-up resulted in a life-changing diagnosis…

Read More...

### Lillian Wellington’s Wellspring of Gratitude for Neurosurgeon Dr. Anthony D’Ambrosio

“He is not an ordinary person. He was helpful and he was the only one who could help me…”

Read More...

### See the Possibilities: Naomi’s Story Before and After Selective Dorsal Rhizotomy

“Dr. Anderson was incredibly comforting. We had such a sense of confidence in him, in the surgery he
was about to perform…”

Read More...

### Heart-felt Letter of Gratitude to NJ Neurosurgeon Dr. Anthony D’Ambrosio

“I truly feel that not only do I owe my life to you, but that I was blessed to find myself placed in
your more than capable hands…”

Read More...

### Neurosurgeon Dr. Gaetan Moise Lauded by Happy Patient

“How do I begin to thank God and you for giving me my life back? I am a true miracle. Your skills as
a neurosurgeon and compassion as a human being made me so comfortable being in your care. …”

Read More...

#### Overview

### Designed to Deliver Excellence

Founded in 2015 in California, NeuroVasc Technologies brings over 100 years of combined expertise in
neurovascular device design and development. We are committed to being the most efficient and
innovative developer of neurovascular treatment devices in the world.

NeuroVasc is focused on developing a portfolio of novel catheter-based technologies to facilitate
broad treatment options for patients suffering stroke and other neurovascular diseases.

## Worldwide Distribution

Since its founding in 2015, NeuroVasc has been dedicated to developing innovative and breakthrough
solutions for the treatment of neurovascular diseases.

We currently have clearance to serve patients in more than 35 countries, and our technologies are
rapidly becoming accessible to more patients across the world.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

#### Data Collection

sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry

segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

indicators.

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder

## SOLUTIONS

# INNOVATIONS IN CARING

### TERUMO INTERVENTIONAL SYSTEMS (TIS)

TIS is a market leader in providing solutions that enable minimally invasive entry site management,
lesion access and therapeutic intervention for cardiology, peripheral arterial disease,
embolotherapy and interventional oncology.

### TERUMO HEALTH OUTCOMES (THO)

THO partners with clinicians and hospitals to help them improve patient outcomes, optimize
operations and provide process investment guidance that can lead to cost savings. 

### TERUMO MEDICAL PRODUCTS (TMP)

TMP designs injection and infusion therapy devices that allow clinicians to deliver the very best
day-to-day care to their patients in both the human and animal health markets.

### PHARMACEUTICAL SOLUTIONS DIVISION (PSD)

PSD offers pharmaceutical and medical device companies worldwide comprehensive product design and
development services.

#### CAREERS

Looking for a rewarding and meaningful career? Then Terumo is where you want to be. When you join
our team, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique skillset to make a real difference at
one of the most admired medical device companies in the industry.
